refnamediv.refpurpose: Set the output format of string values

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
voidsnmp_set_string_output_format Snmp\StringOutputformat
Sets the format in which the Net-SNMP library prints the string values returned by the SNMP functions, such as snmp2_get or snmp2_real_walk. The format only applies to string values whose MIB object has no DISPLAY-HINT.
A new SNMP object takes its initial string output format from the value set with this function. To change it for a single session, use SNMP::setStringOutputFormat instead.
